acceptance_criteria: New public types in `swx-kernel`: `Workplane { origin: Point3, x_dir: [f64; 3], normal: [f64; 3] }`, with `Workplane::XY`, `XZ` and `YZ` constants. `Segment2`: `Line { start, end }`, `Arc { center, radius, start_angle, end_angle }` (counterclockwise from start to end, in radians, the same convention as `swx_sketch::Arc`) and `Circle { center, radius }`. `ProfileLoop { segments: Vec<Segment2> }`. `Extent`: `Distance(f64)` (signed, along `normal`; negative goes the other way) and `Symmetric(f64)` (total length, split equally on both sides).

`Kernel::make_face(&self, plane: &Workplane, outer: &ProfileLoop, holes: &[ProfileLoop]) -> Result<Shape, KernelError>`. It returns an error, and never panics, for: a loop whose consecutive segments don't meet within 1e-7; an empty loop; non-finite numbers; `x_dir` and `normal` that are zero or not perpendicular within 1e-9 (both are normalized); a radius ≤ 0; a face OCCT reports as invalid, for example a self-intersecting outer loop or a hole outside the outer loop. A test covers each case.
`Kernel::extrude(&self, face: &Shape, extent: Extent) -> Result<Shape, KernelError>`. A distance or symmetric length of 0, or one that isn't finite, is an error.

Plate test: on `Workplane::XY`, a 40 × 25 rectangle from (0, 0), with a hole of radius 5 centered at (20, 12.5), `Distance(10)`. Volume 10000 − 250π ≈ 9214.6018 within a relative 1e-6. Bounding box (0, 0, 0)–(40, 25, 10) within 1e-6. Face count 7.
Slot test: lines and arcs. Two straight sides 30 long, two semicircular ends of radius 5, `Distance(4)`. Volume 4 × (300 + 25π) ≈ 1514.1593 within a relative 1e-6. Face count 6.

Direction tests: `Distance(-10)` on the plate gives z from −10 to 0. `Symmetric(10)` gives z from −5 to 5. The same rectangle on `Workplane::YZ` with `Distance(10)` gives the box (0, 0, 0)–(10, 40, 25). A workplane with origin (0, 0, 20) gives z from 20 to 30. Each within 1e-6.
The extruded plate round-trips through `export_step` / `import_step` with the same volume (relative 1e-6) and face count.
No new dependencies. The ARCHITECTURE.md dependency direction is unchanged: `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
